xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4532: Dashboard restart during verification loses the review dispatch; re-request discards the finished result and re-runs all gates

plan.title: Dashboard restart during verification loses the review dispatch; re-request discards the finished result and re-runs all gates
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A verification worker survives a dashboard restart and writes passed, but its waiter died with the old process; the re-request ignored the finished result and re-ran every gate.
narratives.Proposal: Adopt an unconsumed result whose verified head is the current head under the PAN-4527 same-head rule, record consumption so a result is used once, and re-attach request-review continuations to surviving workers on dashboard boot.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to deacon-lite recoverUndispatchedReviews
- No adoption of merge-verification workers
- No new HTTP route, CLI verb or setting

items.title: Adopt an unconsumed verification result for the current head

expected_outputs: npx vitest run src/lib/cloister/__tests__/verification-worker-supervisor-join.test.ts completes without errors

narrative.Action: runSupervisedVerificationInternal returns an unconsumed, same-options, non-error result whose head is the current head, and marks it consumed.

items.title: Given a finished passed result for the current HEAD and no consumer, when review is re-requested, then no new worker starts and the result is returned
Given a finished result, when the agent has committed since, then a fresh worker starts
Given a result already consumed, or a result whose consumption write fails, when review is re-requested, then it is not adopted and a fresh worker runs
Re-attach request-review continuations to surviving workers on boot

expected_outputs: npx vitest run src/lib/cloister/__tests__/verification-worker-supervisor-join.test.ts completes without errors

narrative.Action: adoptSurvivingVerificationWorkers lists live or unconsumed request-review workers and starts the request-review pipeline for each with source verification-adoption; main.ts calls it on boot.

items.title: Given worker states on disk, when listAdoptableVerificationWorkers runs, then it lists only running and unconsumed request-review workers
Given a live request-review worker at dashboard boot, when it later writes passed, then review dispatches with no re-request and no new worker
Document that verification survives a dashboard restart
